Use τ_i=σ^(−i)τ_0 in D07/D08, track the p^Z model scaling/choices in S10/S12, and formulate framing tensors with their Tate/filtration and G-valued Hodge-cocharacter conditions. Updating sourceIssues alone does not repair the mathematical items.

Confirmed a proof-closure gap in the ramified reductive case of Theorem 1.4, pp. 425–426. Restriction of scalars along a ramified integer extension does not preserve reductivity: for a quadratic ramified extension, the special fibre of Res G_m has a nontrivial additive unipotent part. Thus the O_0 reductive case cannot justify ramified properness via that reduction. This does not disprove Theorem 1.4. Separate representability from properness, then supply properness using the §1.4.2 Demazure argument after representability, with base-change/descent and exact group hypotheses, or another complete proof. Record the gap without declaring the theorem false.

Split representability and properness and order them separately. G24 uses G04, G17 uses the quotient Grassmannian/Tor input A263, and the Gabber input of R05 needs an actual supplier edge. The 104 named additions currently have no incoming edges.
